changelog:
Initial release of GDPR Data Export Tool — a comprehensive framework for compliant DSAR processing.

- Supports Article 15 (right of access), Article 20 (data portability), CCPA/CPRA right-to-know, and UK DPA SARs.
- Guides on subject identification/authentication, data inventory (covering SQL/NoSQL/SaaS stores), pipeline design, export packaging, and secure delivery.
- Includes workflow for audit logging, SLA tracking, shared-data handling, and vendor coordination.
- Provides comparison matrix for Article 15 vs 20 requirements and a detailed data inventory worksheet template.
- Useful for designing, auditing, or operating privacy-compliant data export pipelines.
